marketing_description: The SATCO Direct Wire Downlight, part of the Contractor Select collection, is a 24 W, 120 V recessed lighting solution with a round baffle trim and frosted polycarbonate lens. This dimmable LED downlight features a 90 deg beam angle and is available in a range of color temperatures, including 2700 K, 3000 K, 3500 K, 4000 K, and 5000 K. The air-tight and IC rated design makes it suitable for various applications, with a 4 in trim size and a white steel finish.
